about.description: KNIGHT is the governance and coordination token for CitaDAO, a real estate-focused protocol that structures property-linked positions into onchain assets designed for composability and collateral-style use cases. The platform’s framing is centered on making premium real estate exposure more accessible through fractional units and protocol-governed vault mechanics, with KNIGHT used for governance, incentives, and ecosystem alignment.
